name: Pizza Meatball
recipeIngredient: 12 oz frozen meatballs, thawed and cut in half

recipeInstructions.text: Place pizza crust in a pizza pan or on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese over the crust.
Place meatballs on top of the cheese, cut side down.
Spread remaining pizza sauce over the meatballs.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and Italian seasoning.
Bake in a 400°F oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted.
Cut into pizza wheels and serve.

_similar.name: Pizza Bagels (Kids Style)
_similar.description: A quick and easy microwave pizza bagel recipe perfect for kids, topped with pizza sauce, mozzarella, and favorite toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the bagel in half and spoon pizza sauce on each half.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the sauce.
Add your favorite pizza toppings.
Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes until the cheese melts. Be careful as they can be hot.

_similar.keywords: pizza bagel, microwave recipe, kids meal

_similar.name: Pizza
_similar.description: A homemade pizza recipe with a yeast-based crust, topped with spaghetti sauce, various meats, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 10 minutes.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl. Make a well and pour in the yeast mixture. Stir and add oil gradually, working the dough until thoroughly mixed.
Knead the dough, form into a ball, and let stand in a warm place for approximately 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Roll out the dough on a floured pastry board to an even thickness. Transfer to a pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Cover with spaghetti sauce, meats, mushrooms, and other toppings. Finish with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before cutting and serving.
Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.

_similar.name: Florentine Lasagna Rolls
_similar.description: Lasagna noodles rolled with a spinach and ricotta cheese mixture, baked in a creamy Alfredo sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain and plunge into cold water.
In a medium saucepan, combine Alfredo sauce mix, milk, and butter. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly with a whisk.
Reduce heat to medium-low. Add red peppers and simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour half of the sauce into a greased large square baking dish.
Drain spinach, pressing out extra moisture. Combine with ricotta cheese, mozzarella cheese, eggs, and nutmeg.
Drain noodles and pat dry. Spread spinach mixture evenly over noodles. Roll up and place seam-down in the baking dish.
Top with remaining sauce. Cover and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 to 40 minutes or until the sauce is bubbling.

_similar.keywords: lasagna rolls, Florentine, spinach, ricotta, Alfredo sauce

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine
